description: Everything a repository with a public pitch needs to keep its words true: the marketing-quality rule (a gate, twenty-one non-negotiables and six depth files on positioning, claims, trust claims, the first screen, voice and discoverability), the positioning-brief, release-notes, marketing-review and marketing-measurement skills, and eight channel skills (channel-publishing, github-presence, linkedin-post, youtube-video, microblog-post, terminal-demo, community-post and launch-plan) that end every task at a draft for a named human to post.
name: product-essentials
summary: The product surface set: a marketing rule with a positioning record and claims evidence, procedures for release notes, measurement and review, and the public-channel skills
